# [CS040] GraphQL Query Complexity Not Limited (graphql-unbounded-query)

A GraphQL server has no complexity or depth limit.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | MEDIUM |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-400](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/400.html) |
| **OWASP** | A06:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Nested queries over relations grow exponentially, so a single request can make the server load millions of objects. Set a complexity limit.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
srv := handler.NewDefaultServer(es)
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
srv := handler.New(es)
srv.Use(extension.FixedComplexityLimit(200))
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [graphql-unbounded-query]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    graphql-unbounded-query: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore graphql-unbounded-query -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** graphql-unbounded-query
```
